criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS BuildingShapesZip4 feature FID 781 is named Chi Omega and lists 402 Waldron St.
Fresh Blender 4.5.15 reopen found 14 ground-ring vertices; ordered reversed ring error is 0.000013 m and the symmetric nearest-vertex error is 0.0001 m.
Purdue Board of Trustees 2023 property memorandum identifies 402 Waldron as the existing house site and distinguishes the separately proposed new facility parcels.
criteria.findings: Identity and horizontal footprint are well-supported. GIS snapshot does not state a capture date; address corroboration is present.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: The massing is stored in campus coordinates with identity object transform, as required for simple massing assets.

The building perimeter matches the GIS polygon after the repository documented WGS84-to-local approximation; the ordered perimeter matches in reverse winding, so orientation and plan dimensions follow that source polygon.
The comparison inherits the local geographic approximation and GIS source accuracy; this is not a surveyed coordinate verification.
criteria.findings: Position, orientation and plan dimensions are verified against the selected GIS feature, subject to its source precision and local conversion.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Indiana orthophoto (2022–2025 mosaic; local capture date unspecified) visibly supports a multi-wing roof silhouette and several roof zones.
The model contains four simplified hip-roof volumes; no retrieved elevation, section, or dated source validates roof pitch, exact roof segmentation, eave height, or peak height.

GIS NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO both say 1, but the source provides no definitions or measurement basis; GIS Extrution=12 has no declared unit. The model correctly labels 7.8 m eave and 10.3 m peak as estimates.
criteria.findings: Roof massing is aerial-informed but approximate. Floor count and all vertical dimensions remain unverified, so half credit is withheld.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: No building elevation or usable facade photograph is included in the evidence set; the archive inventory only identifies historical Chi Omega photographs, without a retrieved image used for this candidate.
The rendered preview shows generic repeated two-row windows, neutral masonry, and trim. The build script labels these elements illustrative; no entrance or verified distinctive feature is modeled.
The Purdue property memo and chapter address corroborate identity and site only; neither supports facade details.
criteria.findings: Visual plausibility is not source evidence. Minimal credit recognizes the candidate records these elements as illustrative rather than claiming verification.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender 4.5.15 process reopened the asset and found the expected scene, asset collection, and one mesh object named Chi Omega.
The object transform is identity, with no modifiers, linked libraries, or unpacked external images; the asset is a portable campus-coordinate massing library.

Building-specific evidence includes raw GIS JSON, orthophoto snapshots, Board memorandum, source metadata, build result, preview, and a builder reopen record. Sources record URL/provider, feature, retrieval date, source date when known, CRS/method, and uncertainty.
criteria.findings: Export and evidence organization meet the modular requirements. Source dates and vertical evidence limitations are disclosed.

findings: The GIS footprint and XY placement match strongly, and the library reopens cleanly.
Only the general roof-zone silhouette is supported by the available aerial image. Height and story count are estimates/unverified.
Facade rhythm, entrance, materials, and architectural identity are illustrative and lack a retrieved building-specific elevation/photo.
Overall score is below the required 8/10. Candidate requires revision plus a fresh independent grade before acceptance.
